question: Should OpenClaw accept stream and computed dashboard bindings in the bundled dashboard stack now, and should this external PR's dependency graph change be authorized or scrubbed before merge?
rationale: The feature extends an unshipped bundled-plugin API, touches security-sensitive stream data exposure, and is blocked by external dependency-graph approval, so automation cannot choose the permanent product/security boundary.

options.title: Repair Before Merge
options.body: Keep `command` deferred, update all dashboard write surfaces and ordering semantics, resolve the dependency guard, rebase on the accepted dashboard stack, and require live stream/computed proof before merge.

options.title: Authorize Dependency Risk
options.body: Maintainers can explicitly approve the package/lockfile changes, but the write-surface bugs and live proof gap still need resolution before landing.

options.title: Pause Dashboard Bindings
options.body: Close or pause this PR until the base modular dashboard product direction and custom-widget security boundary are accepted.

recommendation.title: Repair Before Merge
recommendation.body: Keep `command` deferred, update all dashboard write surfaces and ordering semantics, resolve the dependency guard, rebase on the accepted dashboard stack, and require live stream/computed proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent Control UI/plugin-tab ownership makes this the best available maintainer routing signal for the product/security boundary decision.
